originality.rationale: The 2013 source states the all-cq inequality as Conjecture 2 and proves only the two-label pure-state case. Exact claim and alias searches found no tight-frame/projective-design formulation giving the harmonic-number conditional-subentropy formula. A 2026 paper does prove the separate discrimination fact p_guess=d/n for equal-prior tight frames; the present claim explicitly treats that ingredient as prior and contributes the exact conditional-subentropy evaluation and resulting infinite conjecture sector. The remaining risk is differently indexed literature using projective-design terminology.
residual_risks: A later result could phrase the same conditional-subentropy computation under complex projective one-design, isotropic ensemble, or frame-entropy terminology and evade the searches performed.

value.rationale: The 2013 paper leaves the higher-dimensional cq guessing bound conjectural beyond its two-label proof and numerical three-label evidence. The finding proves the conjecture for a natural infinite class central to quantum measurement and design theory, in every finite dimension, and yields an exact quantitative gap rather than a yes/no bound. The class contains arbitrary equal-weight projective one-designs, so the contribution is structural rather than a one-parameter or isolated example. Its scope is honestly limited to equal priors, pure signals, and maximally mixed average.
